title: Google Launches EmbeddingGemma 2 as First Open Multimodal Embedding Model

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Up to 58 video frames or 5.5 minutes of audio can be processed in a single pass to enable local search and retrieval. Google and Google DeepMind released EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740M parameter open model that unifies text, code, image, video, and audio into a single embedding space under an Apache 2.0 license. The system outperforms some specialist models over twice its size, utilizes between 191MB and 567MB of active RAM, and provides a 9.92 point improvement in code performance over the previous version. Weights are available now on Hugging Face and Kaggle.

The architecture features an 8K context window, which is four times larger than the original text only version, to optimize on device efficiency for mobile and desktop. When paired with Gemma 4, the model powers privacy first retrieval augmented generation by accessing and reasoning over local files entirely offline. Support for the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Model Garden follows.

selectedTweets.text:
Introducing EmbeddingGemma 2! 🚀

Our lightweight, multimodal embedding model maps text, code, images, video, and audio into a single, unified embedding space. Optimized for on-device use cases, it features:

- 740M parameter form factor with modular encoders
- Flexible dimension sizes (768dim-128dim) via Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL)
- 8K context window (4x larger than text-only EmbeddingGemma)
- A commercially permissive Apache 2.0 license

selectedTweets.bestBit: outperforms some models over twice its size while using from as little as ~191MB to 567MB of active RAM
selectedTweets.text:
Best-in-class for its size at 740M parameters, EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms some models over twice its size while using from as little as ~191MB to 567MB of active RAM.

It also features a 4x larger 8K context window than the first generation, processing up to 5.5 minutes of audio, 29 images, or 58 video frames in one pass.

SGLang has Day-0 support for EmbeddingGemma 2 from @GoogleDeepMind!

EmbeddingGemma 2 is a multimodal embedding model. It maps text, code, images, video, and audio into one shared 768d embedding space.
- 4 modalities with interleaved inputs, 8K context, 100+ languages
- Flexible footprint: modular encoders from 270M (text-only) to 740M (all modalities), plus Matryoshka embeddings

Get started with SGLang
